episodes.title: Piloto
episodes.summary: On the series premiere of QUEEN OF THE SOUTH the Mexican drug cartel comes after Teresa Mendoza with a vengeance and she is forced to run and do whatever it takes to survive. Teresa's fate is sealed in the dangerous narco world forever and she has to prove her worth to Camila. Meanwhile, Epifanio gets closer in his hunt. Back in Mexico, Brenda desperately tries to find Teresa and hide from the cartel.

episodes.title: Cuarenta Minutos
episodes.summary: Still reeling from the loss of Guero's (Jon Ecker) and her escape to America, Teresa has to fend for herself and avoids being forced into prostitution by proving her worth to Camila. Epifanio's hunt for Teresa leads him to contact Camila. Meanwhile, in Mexico, Brenda, desperately tries to contact Teresa as she and Tony evade Epifanio's hit men.

episodes.title: Estrategia de Entrada
episodes.summary: Camila sends Teresa on a major drug operation to test her loyalty. When Teresa plays a pivotal role in the pickup, she takes a real step toward being trapped into Camila's dark narco world. Camila enlists Teo, a high-powered lawyer, to help her with first big secretive move into taking over Epifanio's cartel. Meanwhile, Brenda, still on the run, finally makes contact with Teresa, who helps her escape, but not how she expected.

episodes.title: Lirio de los Valles
episodes.summary: An unexpected and deadly hiccup mars Teresa's first solo drug run, forcing James and Camila to clean up the mess. Teresa soon finds herself in further when one of Epifanio's hitmen, "Batman" (Gerardo Taracena) discovers that she's in Dallas, which also forces Camila to make a risky deal on Teresa's behalf. Meanwhile, Brenda and Tony arrive in Dallas.

episodes.title: Un Alma. Un Mapa. Dos Futuros.
episodes.summary: Teresa advances her plans after witnessing a horrific incident; and Brenda, who's safely in Dallas, begins assembling a team to help her sell drugs.

episodes.title: El Engaño Como la Regla
episodes.summary: Camila, who's deep in debt and short on supply, contemplates giving up Teresa; and Brenda's drug enterprise causes problems between her and Tony.

episodes.title: El Hombre Pájaro
episodes.summary: Camila sends Teresa on a dangerous mission; and Brenda, facing a supply shortage, puts her crew in the line of fire.

episodes.title: Billete de Magia
episodes.summary: Camila attempts a risky heist; and Teresa is forced to make a life-changing decision while undercover.

episodes.title: Coge Todo Lo Que Puede Llevar
episodes.summary: Teresa tries to save a witness to the heist; and a confident Camila vows that she's back in business and is done with Epifanio.

episodes.title: Esta 'Cosa' Que Es Nuestra
episodes.summary: Camila returns to Mexico in order to protect herself; James hunts Teresa; and Teresa faces danger while taking Maria through the tunnel to Mexico.

episodes.title: Punto Sin Retorno
episodes.summary: Camila's operation goes underground when James finally sets out to kill "The Birdman" (Brent Smiga) in a strategic move to align with the Jimenez Cartel. Fed up, Brenda finds herself caught in the crossfire of an escalating drug cartel war. Meanwhile, Epifanio struggles to keep his campaign moving while dodging public rumors of his link to the drug trade violence.

episodes.title: Quinientos Mil
episodes.summary: Out of options, Teresa and Brenda find themselves in a desperate situation, playing a dangerous extortion game. Camila sends James on a deadly mission.

episodes.title: Cicatriz
episodes.summary: Teresa, determined to escape and save Brenda, risks her life to protect the book by any means necessary. Meanwhile, in his campaign for Governor, Epifanio obtains new intel that changes everything.

episodes.title: El Cuerpo de Cristo
episodes.summary: Teresa brokers a deal with an eccentric smuggler; Camila struggles to rebuild her empire; Epifanio takes on a new partner he may not be able to control.

episodes.title: Dios y el Abogado
episodes.summary: Old enemies and old flames threaten to tear everything apart when Teresa and crew rig a high-stakes narco horse race.

episodes.title: Un Pacto Con el Diablo
episodes.summary: On a mission to destroy Epifanio's drug smuggling tunnels, Teresa and James come face-to-face with a group of American border vigilantes.

episodes.title: El Beso de Judas
episodes.summary: Teresa's loyalties are tested when she is ordered to hunt down and kill a DEA mole.

episodes.title: El Nacimiento de Bolivia
episodes.summary: Teresa, James and Guero travel to Bolivia in search of a new supplier: the mysterious and dangerous narco-cult leader El Santo.

episodes.title: El Camino de la Muerte
episodes.summary: Captured by narco-cult leader El Santo, Teresa embarks on a spiritual journey with real-world consequences.

episodes.title: El Precio de Fe
episodes.summary: With the deadline for El Santo's payment looming, Teresa and Camila must find a new distributor—but familiar enemies threaten to derail their plans.

episodes.title: Sacar Con Sifón El Mar
episodes.summary: Camila sends Teresa and her crew to Chicago to secure a meeting with an elusive drug distributor.

episodes.title: Sólo el Amor de Una Madre
episodes.summary: An uncharacteristic blunder forces Camila and Teresa to go on the run from hit men, but as they flee, their bond grows deeper.

episodes.title: Que Manden los Payasos
episodes.summary: When Teresa competes with James for Camila's trust, she begins to question everything; Epifanio plans to leave the cartel world for good.

episodes.title: La Noche Oscura del Alma
episodes.summary: Teresa goes on the run from Camila, but after a violent showdown with some hired guns, she realizes that the time for running is over. Now it's time for war.

episodes.title: Todas las Horas Hieren
episodes.summary: Determined to break away from Camila for good, Teresa forges new, uneasy alliances -- and for the first time, she brings the fight to Camila's doorstep.

episodes.title: La Última Hora Mata
episodes.summary: Destinies and desires collide in a final showdown between Teresa and Camila, forcing them to accept one absolute truth: there can only be one queen.

episodes.title: La Ermitaña
episodes.summary: Hiding from Camila in Malta, Teresa tries to launch a drug empire of her own by striking a deal with a dangerous money launderer.

episodes.title: El Colgado
episodes.summary: On the run from hitmen in Malta, Teresa is helped by an old friend, whose intentions are anything but clear.

episodes.title: Reina de Oros
episodes.summary: Teresa puts her life and her empire on the line when she attempts to rescue girls being trafficked by her new European business partner.

episodes.title: La Fuerza
episodes.summary: Teresa flees Europe and starts fresh in Phoenix, Arizona, where she must deal with a commission of cartel bosses and a corrupt local sheriff.

episodes.title: El Juicio
episodes.summary: An old enemy lays siege to Teresa's new Phoenix winery, and in defending her business she finds passion with an old friend.

episodes.title: Los Enamorados
episodes.summary: Teresa tries to escape her captors with the help of an unexpected ally.

episodes.title: La Reina de Espadas
episodes.summary: Rocked by a deeply personal tragedy, Teresa battles a dangerous sicario and a mutiny within her own ranks.

episodes.title: El Carro
episodes.summary: In a bold plan to take over all drug distribution in Phoenix, Teresa makes a deal with the devil.

episodes.title: El Diablo
episodes.summary: To help wipe out her rivals in Phoenix, Teresa gets into bed with an ambitious politician.

episodes.title: La Muerte
episodes.summary: Returning to Bolivia, Teresa risks her life to prove her loyalty to El Santo.

episodes.title: Diez de Copas
episodes.summary: Teresa hunts for a mole inside her own operation, and faces a terrible choice.

episodes.title: Justicia
episodes.summary: Teresa tries to free a friend from his cage and comes face to face with her sworn enemy.

episodes.title: El Mundo
episodes.summary: Reeling from a surprise attack, Teresa makes a bold move to seize the throne.

episodes.title: Bienvenidos a Nuevo Orleans
episodes.summary: Teresa expands her business and proves herself to a smuggler who offers her a business opportunity.

episodes.title: Un Asunto de Familia
episodes.summary: Teresa's deal with a smuggler goes sideways when a local kingpin discovers she's smuggling cocaine

episodes.title: Hospitalidad Sureña
episodes.summary: A corrupt judge wants in on Teresa's deal when he learns about her business.

episodes.title: La Maldición
episodes.summary: While Javier and Boaz deal with a personal problem, Teresa gets involved in a deadly turf war.

episodes.title: Noche de las Chicas
episodes.summary: El Gordo introduces Teresa to Russian drug queenpin Oksana in the hopes of forging a partnership.

episodes.title: La Mujer en el Espejo
episodes.summary: Dealing with the losses of a drug war, Teresa and Dumas finally strike a truce.

episodes.title: Amores Perros
episodes.summary: On her day off, Teresa is hunted by a sicario from her previous life while on the road.

episodes.title: Secretos y Mentiras
episodes.summary: An FBI informant threatens Teresa's growing empire while she deals with turmoil within her family.

episodes.title: Los Pecados de los Padres
episodes.summary: Teresa must choose between leaving New Orleans and compromising her morals.

episodes.title: Lo Que Más Temes
episodes.summary: Teresa works to ease tensions between her business partners after she discovers that someone is stealing from her.

episodes.title: Mientras Dormías
episodes.summary: Teresa's closest allies must make difficult decisions without her when she cannot.

episodes.title: Diosa de la Guerra
episodes.summary: Teresa takes out a group of mercenaries while expanding her empire to an unexpected place.

episodes.title: Vienen Por Ti
episodes.summary: Teresa must solidify a new business deal to take down an enemy - but an unexpected visitor arrives.

episodes.title: Fantasmas
episodes.summary: Teresa sets out to expand her business in New York City while James proves his allegiance to Teresa.

episodes.title: Me Llevo Manhattan
episodes.summary: With tensions rising, Teresa arranges a sit-down in New York between the Dominicans and the Russians.

episodes.title: No Te Pierdas La Cabeza
episodes.summary: After the Judge places a bounty on Dumas's head, Teresa sends James to rescue him.

episodes.title: La Situacion
episodes.summary: With the Judge dead and Dumas behind bars, Teresa finds herself in the crosshairs of the FBI.

episodes.title: Mas Dinero Mas Problemas
episodes.summary: Teresa travels to Germany after Oksana gets cheated in a drug deal.

episodes.title: Plata O Plomo
episodes.summary: Teresa solidifies her European foothold while George makes a discovery about Boaz's Miami operation.

episodes.title: El Zorro en La Gallinera
episodes.summary: Boaz makes moves to dismantle the Mendoza Cartel once and for all.

episodes.title: Todo Lo Que Toco
episodes.summary: After Teresa puts her life on the line for Pote and Kelly Anne, the war with Boaz intensifies.

episodes.title: A Prueba De Balas
episodes.summary: Pote and Kelly Anne adapt to suburban life; Teresa and James are forced to go after Kostya.

episodes.title: El Final
episodes.summary: Pote, Kelly Anne and James try to disappear, but must fend off attacks from Devon Finch and Boaz.
